source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: The most productive and universal verbalizer is –LAA1. Its universality is witnessed by its ability to attach not only to nouns (and adjectives) but also to cardinal and ordinal numerals (17), adverbs (18), interjections (19), interrogative and quantifying demonstrative pronouns (20). (21) shows some examples of de-pronominal LAA-verbs in usage.
en: What did you do with my coat?
